title: textures.json
description: Every texture the bundle uses, for materials, lightmaps, skies, reflections, Grades and thumbnails. Its file is textures/<id>.<format>, top row first.

id.description: The Content Hash of the full-size decoded pixels, before any size limit (ADR 0012).

format.description: png: 8 bits per channel. exr: half float, for HDR values (D21).

color_space.description: srgb: the file holds sRGB-encoded colours, which the game decodes when it samples them. linear: the values are used as stored (masks, normal maps, LUTs, lightmap directions, HDR).

wrap.description: The wrap mode along U and V.
